heading: Seamen’s clothing
lead: The clothing of a seaman is exempt from attachments and liens. A person detaining a seaman’s clothing shall be fined not more than $500, imprisoned for not more than 6 months, or both.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 1111046:563 Section 11110 exempts seamen’s clothing from attachments and liens. It also provides a penalty for violations.
